definitions.full: H3025. yagor [ יָגֹר ] verb be afraid, fear (Phoenician in proper name אשמן יגר = he feareth Eshmun ; Arabic metuens cavit , Frey Lag BN 26.30 ; compare III. גּוּר ) — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular יָגֹרְתָּ Deut 28:60 ; יָגֹּרְתִּי 9:19 3 t.; — be afraid , followed by מִמְּנֵי before, of ; of wrath of ׳י 9:19 ; of diseases of Egypt 28:60 ; fear , followed by accusative Job 3:25 ; 9:28 ; Psa 119:39 .
